versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "Apply Altshuller/TRIZ Thinking" skill.

- Provides a structured framework for applying TRIZ concepts to engineering and invention problems.
- Outlines clear protocols for analyzing technical and physical contradictions, ideal final results (IFR), system definition, and tool selection.
- Supplies guidance on ranking and validating solution alternatives using TRIZ principles.
- Emphasizes limitations of TRIZ and appropriate use cases, including caution for non-engineering problems.
- Includes summaries of five core TRIZ mental models to inform inventive problem-solving.
